description: This file defines the interface class IGstGenericPlayerClient for the Rialto GStreamer player. It declares methods for notifying the client about playback state, media data needs, position updates, network state, QoS updates, and buffer underflow events. The interface is intended for implementation by objects that wish to receive notifications about the GStreamer player's state and data flow.

classes.name: IGstGenericPlayerClient
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for GStreamer player client notifications, including methods for playback state, media data requests, position updates, network state, QoS, and buffer underflow events.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notify the client of the current playback state (e.g., IDLE, PLAYING, PAUSED, SEEKING, FLUSHED, STOPPED).

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify the client that media data is needed for a specific media source type; returns true on success.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notify the client of the current playback position in nanoseconds.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Notify the client of the current network state.

methods.name: clearActiveRequestsCache
methods.description: Clear all active media data request caches.

methods.name: invalidateActiveRequests
methods.description: Invalidate active media data requests for a specific media source type.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notify the client of a QoS update for a specific media source type.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notify the client that a buffer underflow has occurred for a specific media source type.
